statement: An employer must make a compulsory employer contribution of at least 3.5% of gross salary or wages for each employee who is aged 16 and over and under 65, is in KiwiSaver or a complying fund with contributions deducted from their pay, and is not a member of a defined benefit scheme, unless the employee is on a temporary rate reduction.
caveat: The compulsory rate rose from 3% to 3.5% in 2026 and further legislated step-ups are scheduled, so the figure is the most change-prone number on this card; employer superannuation contribution tax (ESCT) applies on top. Check the live Inland Revenue page for the current rate before payroll setup.
